questions.question: Current density is ______ proportional to the size of the electrode.

questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Fundamentals of Electro Therapy

questions.question: Which of the following pairs is correct?

options.A: Cohort study is prospective and case-control study is retrospective
options.D: Cohort study is retrospective and case-control is prospective

questions.explanation: Cohorts are followed forward in time; case-control studies look backward.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Community Health

questions.question: Attributing one's own unacceptable feelings to another person is called:
questions.explanation: Repression is pushing unwanted thoughts out of awareness.
questions.sourceBook: Morgan & King, Introduction to Psychology (chapter-level reference)
questions.subject: Psychology

questions.question: Distance from the knee joint in below knee amputation is......inches.
questions.explanation: The standard below-knee residual limb length is about 5.5 inches below the knee joint line.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: Hill Sach's lesion is:
questions.explanation: The Hill-Sachs lesion is a compression defect of the posterolateral humeral head after anterior shoulder dislocation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: General Surgery & Orthopedics

questions.question: Claudication pain that is unbearable and excruciating is graded as:
questions.explanation: On the 4-point scale: 1 minimal, 2 moderate, 3 intense, 4 excruciating.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: Systemic anaphylaxis is a type of:
questions.explanation: Mediated by IgE-induced mast cell degranulation.
questions.sourceBook: Harsh Mohan, Textbook of Pathology; Ananthanarayan & Paniker, Textbook of Microbiology (chapter-level reference)
questions.subject: Pathology & Microbiology

questions.question: The amount of air a person can exhale beyond a resting expiration is the:
questions.explanation: ERV is about 1000 mL.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiology

questions.question: Sensation over the posterior part of the head is supplied by which spinal level?
questions.explanation: The C2 dermatome covers the occiput and posterior scalp; C3 covers the posterolateral neck.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physical Diagnosis & Manipulative Skills

questions.question: A patient status post large rotator cuff repair surgery is referred to physical therapy. Which of the following motions would you initially expect to be the most restricted?
questions.explanation: Lateral rotation is protected and most restricted after large cuff repair.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

Cited reference: Essential of Orthopaedics & Applied Physiotherapy/

Jayant Joshi/1st Ed./Pg. 478 -479

questions.question: The negative pressure applied during endotracheal suctioning in adults is about:
questions.explanation: Adults typically need 100-150 mm Hg; lower pressures are used in children.
questions.sourceBook: Khayti Shah, Question Bank for Physiotherapy Licensure and Entrance Exams
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition

questions.question: Exercise causes a significant increase in the body's cardiac output. During mild to moderate exercise what redistribution of the available cardiac output would you expect?

options.A: An increase in cerebral and coronary blood flow
options.B: A decrease in cerebral and active skeletal muscle blood flow
options.C: An increase in coronary and active skeletal muscle blood flow
options.D: A decrease in cerebral and coronary blood flow

questions.explanation: During exercise cardiac output is redistributed to the working skeletal muscle and the heart.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in General Medical & Surgical Condition
